title: Glowing watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8f7ff' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8f7ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='42' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M28 42 Q20 22 38 18 Q50 16 54 28' fill='none' stroke='#7fe0ff' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 42 Q20 22 38 18 Q50 16 54 28' fill='none' stroke='#d6f9ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M66 44 L92 26' fill='none' stroke='#4fc9e8' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 44 L92 26' fill='none' stroke='#a8edff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout head / rose -->
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='24' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='24' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
  <!-- water drops -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#a8edff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='38' r='2' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#a8edff'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='34' r='1.6' fill='#7fe0ff'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='44' height='38' rx='10' fill='#3bb8d8'/>
  <!-- lighter top panel -->
  <rect x='32' y='42' width='32' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8fe9ff'/>
  <!-- shine stripe -->
  <rect x='33' y='50' width='6' height='22' rx='3' fill='#a8edff' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- rivet dots -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='2' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='66' r='2' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='2' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
  <!-- base rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='72' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2a9dbd'/>
  <rect x='30' y='73' width='36' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#8fe9ff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
